parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The type of the event. Valid values:

*   `cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted`: The delivery chain is processed.
*   `cr:Artifact:SynchronizationCompleted`: The image is replicated.
*   `cr:Artifact:BuildCompleted`: The image is built.
*   `cr:Artifact:ScanCompleted`: The image is scanned.
*   `cr:Artifact:SigningCompleted`: The image is signed.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: RepoNamespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the event notification rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr list-event-center-record --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --event-type cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted --rule-id crecr-n6pbhgjxtla000 --repo-namespace-name test --repo-name test --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr ListEventCenterRecord --region cn-hangzhou --RepoNamespaceName test --PageSize 30 --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --EventType 'cr:Artifact:DeliveryChainCompleted' --RuleId 'crecr-n6pbhgjxtla000' --RepoName test --PageNo 1
